# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated during application analysis.

## Available Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture views with Mermaid diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Dependency inventory grouped by functional categories and version risks.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, contracts, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity relationships, repository methods, and data boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, properties, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows, rules, and end-to-end sequence diagram.
